billing_charge_release_controls_stop_rea.name: billing_charge_release_controls_stop_reason_check
billing_charge_release_controls_stop_rea.value:
("billing_charge_release_controls"."delivery_stopped" = false and "billing_charge_release_controls"."stop_reason" is null and "billing_charge_release_controls"."stopped_at" is null)
        or ("billing_charge_release_controls"."delivery_stopped" = true and "billing_charge_release_controls"."stop_reason" is not null and "billing_charge_release_controls"."stopped_at" is not null)

billing_charge_reservations_finalization.name: billing_charge_reservations_finalization_check
billing_charge_reservations_finalization.value: ("billing_charge_reservations"."status" = 'finalized' and "billing_charge_reservations"."actual_amount_minor" is not null and "billing_charge_reservations"."session_id" is not null and "billing_charge_reservations"."finalized_at" is not null) or ("billing_charge_reservations"."status" <> 'finalized' and "billing_charge_reservations"."actual_amount_minor" is null and "billing_charge_reservations"."session_id" is null and "billing_charge_reservations"."finalized_at" is null)

billing_charge_reservations_release_chec.name: billing_charge_reservations_release_check
billing_charge_reservations_release_chec.value: ("billing_charge_reservations"."status" = 'released' and "billing_charge_reservations"."released_at" is not null) or ("billing_charge_reservations"."status" <> 'released' and "billing_charge_reservations"."released_at" is null)

billing_outbox_charge_promotion_check.name: billing_outbox_charge_promotion_check
billing_outbox_charge_promotion_check.value:
("billing_outbox"."charge_release_id" is null and "billing_outbox"."charge_promoted_at" is null)
        or ("billing_outbox"."charge_release_id" is not null and "billing_outbox"."charge_promoted_at" is not null
          and "billing_outbox"."payload" ->> 'deliveryMode' = 'charge')

billing_release_canary_reports_consent_c.name: billing_release_canary_reports_consent_check
billing_release_canary_reports_consent_c.value:
("billing_release_canary_reports"."canary_type" = 'internal' and "billing_release_canary_reports"."tenant_consent_id" is null)
        or ("billing_release_canary_reports"."canary_type" = 'selected_tenant' and "billing_release_canary_reports"."tenant_consent_id" is not null)

billing_subscription_call_reservations_r.name: billing_subscription_call_reservations_route_check
billing_subscription_call_reservations_r.value: ("billing_subscription_call_reservations"."billing_mode" = 'byo' and "billing_subscription_call_reservations"."route_rate_id" is null and "billing_subscription_call_reservations"."route_identity" is null and "billing_subscription_call_reservations"."route_rate_minor_per_minute" is null and "billing_subscription_call_reservations"."reserved_telephony_minor" = 0) or ("billing_subscription_call_reservations"."billing_mode" = 'platform_managed' and "billing_subscription_call_reservations"."route_rate_id" is not null and "billing_subscription_call_reservations"."route_identity" is not null and "billing_subscription_call_reservations"."route_rate_minor_per_minute" >= 0 and "billing_subscription_call_reservations"."reserved_telephony_minor" >= 0)

billing_terminal_recovery_jobs_lifecycle.name: billing_terminal_recovery_jobs_lifecycle_check
billing_terminal_recovery_jobs_lifecycle.value: ("billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."status" = 'pending' and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."lease_token" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."completed_at" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."dead_lettered_at" is null) or ("billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."status" = 'processing' and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."completed_at" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."dead_lettered_at" is null) or ("billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."status" = 'completed' and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."lease_token" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."completed_at" is not null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."dead_lettered_at" is null) or ("billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."status" = 'dead_letter' and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."lease_token" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."completed_at" is null and "billing_terminal_recovery_jobs"."dead_lettered_at" is not null)

telephony_media_stream_tokens_owner_pair.name: telephony_media_stream_tokens_owner_pair_check
telephony_media_stream_tokens_owner_pair.value:
("telephony_media_stream_tokens"."owner_worker_id" is null and "telephony_media_stream_tokens"."owner_epoch" = 0)
          or ("telephony_media_stream_tokens"."owner_worker_id" is not null and "telephony_media_stream_tokens"."owner_epoch" > 0)
